after.implementation: Chromium / software Mesa ANGLE, real bundled WebGL, original simulated Android room
stdout: PASS 1: a lone phone in slot two controls logical 1P and receives its own telemetry; late spectators cannot change the race
PASS 2: temporary empty host snapshots preserve consumed phone counters when cancelling a native exit dialog
PASS 3: phone cancellation consumes SELECT release and START edges instead of changing camera, gear or pause
PASS 4: native menu counters preserve phone taps between TV frames; cancellation also discards delayed held heartbeats
PASS 5: keyboard repeat cannot unpause; context loss detected before its DOM event recovers without permanent graphics failure
PASS 6: remote B and playback pause work without a phone; legacy optional browser APIs are not required
PASS 7: no-WebGL devices show explicit failure and never silently run an invisible race
PASS 8: renderer false return is treated as a failed draw and suspends the simulation
